examples.text: ሰሞኑን በጀርመን የበረሃዋ አበባ በተሰኘ አንድ በእዉነት ታሪክ ላይ የተመሰረተ ፊልም ለተመልካች ይቀርባል። ፊልሙ በተለይ በአፍሪቃችን በሴቶች እህቶች ላይ የሚፈጸመዉ ግርዛት ጎጂ ልማዳዊ ባህል መሆኑን ለማሳየት የቀረበ ሲሆን ፊልሙ የተቀናበረዉ በአንድ የጀርመን
examples.ref: 2002, Azeb Tadesse, “የበረሃዋ አበባ”, in Deutsche Welle:
examples.english: Recently in Germany, a film based on a true story called Desert Flower will be presented to the audience. The film is especially intended to show that female genital mutilation is a harmful custom in Africa, and the film was composed by a German director.
examples.roman: sämonun bäǧärmän yäbärähawa ʾäbäba bätäsäñä ʾänd bäʾwunät tarik lay yätämäsärätä film lätämälkač yəḳärbal. filmu bätäläy bäʾäfriḳačn bäsetoč ʾəhtoč lay yämifäṣämäwu gərzat goǧi ləmadawi bahl mähonun lämasayät yäḳäräbä sihon filmu yätäḳänabäräwu bäʾänd yäǧärmän
examples.translation: Recently in Germany, a film based on a true story called Desert Flower will be presented to the audience. The film is especially intended to show that female genital mutilation is a harmful custom in Africa, and the film was composed by a German director.

etymology_text: Cognates include Ge'ez ዘንመ (zänmä) and Tigre ዝላም (zəlam).

examples.text: በአፍሪካ ቀንድ ለስድስተኛ ተከታታይ ወቅት ዝናብ ላይጥል እንደሚችል በመገመቱ በቀጠናው አስከፊው ድርቅ ሊቀጥል ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ተቀስቅሷል። የምሥራቅ አፍሪካ ሃገሮች የጋራ ልማት ባለሥልጣን /ኢጋድ/ እና በቀጠናው የአየር ንብረትን የሚቆጣጠር አንድ ተቋም ትላንት ዕረቡ ባወጡት ማስጠንቀቂያ ይጥላል ተብሎ ከሚጠበቀው በእጅጉ ያነሰ ዝናብ ስለሚኖር አስከፊውን ድርቅ የበለጠ ሊያባብሰው እንደሚችል አመላክተዋል።
examples.ref: 2023, “በአፍሪካ ቀንድ አስከፊው ድርቅ ሊቀጥል ይችላል”, in Voice of America News:
examples.english: Fears have been raised that the worst drought in the region may continue as it is predicted that it will not rain for the sixth consecutive season in the Horn of Africa. The Joint Development Authority of East African Countries (IGAD) and an institution that monitors the climate in the region issued a warning yesterday, indicating that there will be much less rain than expected, which could worsen the terrible drought.
examples.roman: bäʾäfrika ḳänd läsdəstäña täkätatay wäḳt zənab layṭəl ʾəndämičl bämägämätu bäḳäṭänaw ʾäskäfiw dərḳ liḳäṭl yəčlal yämil səgat täḳäsḳəsʷal. yämśəraḳ ʾäfrika hagäroč yägara ləmat baläśləṭan /ʾigad/ ʾəna bäḳäṭänaw yäʾäyär nəbrätn yämiḳoṭaṭär ʾänd täḳʷam təlant ʿəräbu bawäṭut masṭänḳäḳiya yəṭlal täblo kämiṭäbäḳäw bäʾǧəgu yanäsä zənab səläminor ʾäskäfiwn dərḳ yäbäläṭä liyababsäw ʾəndämičl ʾämälaktäwal.
examples.translation: Fears have been raised that the worst drought in the region may continue as it is predicted that it will not rain for the sixth consecutive season in the Horn of Africa. The Joint Development Authority of East African Countries (IGAD) and an institution that monitors the climate in the region issued a warning yesterday, indicating that there will be much less rain than expected, which could worsen the terrible drought.

examples.translation: Although Ethiopia, Egypt and Sudan have been negotiating to reach an agreement on the Nile River issue for the past ten years; So far, it has not been possible to reach a comprehensive agreement that would suit all three countries.

examples.text: በአባባልም አንድ ሰው ለረጅም ጊዜ ጠፍቶ ቆይቶ ድንገት ሲከሰት “ምነው የመስቀል ወፍ ሆንክ” ይባላል። ይህም ለረጅም ጊዜ ሳይታዩ ወይም ጠፍቶ ቆይቶ መታየትን ለማመልከት ማኅበረሰቡ የሚጠቀምበት አባባል ነው።
examples.ref: 2023, “የመስቀል ወፍ ወቅት ጠብቃ መስከረም ላይ ብቻ ብቅ የምትል ናት?”, in BBC News:
examples.english: In other words, when a person suddenly reappears after being missing for a long time, it is said, "I wish you were a cross bird." This is a term used by the community to indicate that they have not been seen for a long time or have disappeared.
examples.roman: bäʾäbabalm ʾänd säw läräǧm gize ṭäfto ḳoyto dəngät sikäsät “mənäw yämäsḳäl wäf honk” yəbalal. yəhm läräǧm gize saytayu wäym ṭäfto ḳoyto mätayätn lämamälkät maḫbäräsäbu yämiṭäḳämbät ʾäbabal näw.
examples.translation: In other words, when a person suddenly reappears after being missing for a long time, it is said, "I wish you were a cross bird." This is a term used by the community to indicate that they have not been seen for a long time or have disappeared.

examples.text: በመድረኩም የፆታዊ ጥቃት እና የህፃናት መብትና ደህንነት ዙሪያ ከሴቶች የህግ ባለሙያ ማህበር ወ/ሪት ሰላማዊት ደሳለኝ እንዲሁም የኢንስቲትዩቱ ባለሙያ አቶ አበበ ጌታቸው በእብድ ዉሻ በሽታ ዙሪያ ግንዛቤ ማስጨበጫ ስልጠና ሰጥተዋል።
examples.ref: 2023, “የኢትዮጵያ የሕብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት የሴቶች፣ ህጻናት እና ወጣቶች ጉዳይ ዳይሬክቶሬት በፆታዊ ጥቃት፣ የህፃናት መብትና ደህንነት እንዲሁም የእብድ ዉሻ በሽታ (RABIES) ዙሪያ ከአዲስ ከተማ ክ/ከተማ እና ከጉለሌ ክ/ከተማ ለተወጣጡ ባለሞያዎች በኢንስቲትዩቱ መሰብሰቢያ አዳራሽ የግንዛቤ ማስጨበጫ ስልጠና ሰጥቷል”, in Ethiopian Public Health Institute:
examples.english: In the forum, women's lawyer's association, Mrs. Seifouit Desalen and Abebe Getachew, an expert of the institute, gave awareness training on rabies [literally "dog disease"] in the area of sexual violence and children's rights and safety.
examples.roman: bämädräkum yäṣ́otawi ṭəḳat ʾəna yähṣ́anat mäbtəna dähnənät zuriya käsetoč yähg balämuya mahbär wä/rit sälamawit däsaläñ ʾəndihum yäʾinsətityutu balämuya ʾäto ʾäbäbä getačäw bäʾbəd wuša bäšta zuriya gənzabe masč̣äbäč̣a səlṭäna säṭtäwal.
examples.translation: In the forum, women's lawyer's association, Mrs. Seifouit Desalen and Abebe Getachew, an expert of the institute, gave awareness training on rabies [literally "dog disease"] in the area of sexual violence and children's rights and safety.

examples.text: ሙሃሙድ ሁኔታውን ሲያስታውስ፤ "ድንገት አሳው ሲወጋኝ ወደ ሐይቁ ወደኩ። ምሽት ስለነበር ውሃው በጣም ጨልሞ ነበር። አንገቴ ላይ ተቀርቅሮ የገባው አሳው ለማምለጥ ሲሞክር በኃይል ይንቀሳቀስ ነበር" ይላል።

examples.english: When Muhammad remembers the situation; "Suddenly, I fell into the lake when the fish attacked me. It was night, so the water was very dark. The fish that got stuck around my neck was moving violently as it tried to escape," he says.
examples.roman: muhamud hunetawn siyastaws; "dəngät ʾäsaw siwägañ wädä ḥäyḳu wädäku. məšt səlänäbär wəhaw bäṭam č̣älmo näbär. ʾängäte lay täḳärḳəro yägäbaw ʾäsaw lämamläṭ simokr bäḫayl yənḳäsaḳäs näbär" yəlal.

examples.text: ቆም ብለን ብናስብበት እውነታው ሊገለጥልን ይችላል። ሁሉም የሕንፃ መሰረታዊያን ማለትም እነኮንክሪት፣ ጡቦች፣ እንዲሁም መስተዋት ከአሸዋ ነው የሚሰሩት። እጅጉን እየጨመረ የመጣው የሰው ልጅ ቁጥር እና በፍጥነት በማደግ ላይ ያለው የግንባታ ዘርፍ አሸዋን ከውሃ ቀጥሎ በምድራችን ላይ በጣም ተፈላጊው ተፈጥሯዊ ሀብት አድርጎታል። በቢሊዮን ቶን የሚቆጠር አሸዋ በየቀኑ በዓለም ዙሪያ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል።
examples.ref: 2017, “በግንባታዎች ምክንያት እየጨመረ የመጣው የአሸዋ ፍላጎት ወንዞችን እያጠፋ ነው”, in BBC News:
examples.english: If we stop to think about it, the truth can be revealed to us. All building materials, concrete, bricks, and glass are made from sand. The exponentially increasing human population and the rapidly growing construction sector have made sand the most sought-after natural resource on Earth, next to water. Billions of tons of sand are used around the world every day.
examples.roman: ḳom bəlän bənasbəbät ʾəwnätaw ligäläṭlən yəčlal. hulum yäḥnəṣ́a mäsärätawiyan malätm ʾənäkonkərit, ṭuboč, ʾəndihum mästäwat käʾäšäwa näw yämisärut. ʾəǧgun ʾəyäč̣ämärä yämäṭaw yäsäw ləǧ ḳuṭr ʾəna bäfṭənät bämadäg lay yaläw yägnəbata zärf ʾäšäwan käwha ḳäṭlo bämdəračn lay bäṭam täfälagiw täfäṭrʷawi häbt ʾädrəgotal. bäbiliyon ton yämiḳoṭär ʾäšäwa bäyäḳänu bäʿaläm zuriya ṭəḳm lay yəwlal.
examples.translation: If we stop to think about it, the truth can be revealed to us. All building materials, concrete, bricks, and glass are made from sand. The exponentially increasing human population and the rapidly growing construction sector have made sand the most sought-after natural resource on Earth, next to water. Billions of tons of sand are used around the world every day.

examples.text: ዳርታቪየስ ፖሊስን ብቻ ሳይሆን የከተማዋንም አስተዳዳሪዎች ከሷል። የልጁን አመድ በሕገወጥ መንገድ መውሰዳቸው ብቻ ሳይሆን እቃውን ከፍተው የተወሰነ አመድ መሬት ላይ በትነዋል እንዲሁም አደንዛዥ ዕፅ እንመረምራለን በሚልም ውርደት ፈፅመዋል ብሏል።
examples.ref: 2021, “አሜሪካዊው 'የልጄን አመድ ፖሊስ በትኖታል' ሲል ከሰሰ”, in BBC News:
examples.english: Dartavius accused not only the police but also the city administrators. He said that not only did they take the child's ashes illegally, but they also opened the container and scattered some of the ashes on the ground.
examples.roman: dartaviyäs polisn bəča sayhon yäkätämawanm ʾästädadariwoč käsʷal. yälǧun ʾämäd bäḥgäwäṭ mängäd mäwsädačäw bəča sayhon ʾəḳawn käftäw yätäwäsänä ʾämäd märet lay bätnäwal ʾəndihum ʾädänzaž ʿəṣ́ ʾənmärämralän bämilm wərdät fäṣ́mäwal bəlʷal.
examples.translation: Dartavius accused not only the police but also the city administrators. He said that not only did they take the child's ashes illegally, but they also opened the container and scattered some of the ashes on the ground.

etymology_text: From Proto-Semitic *kanap- (“wing”), cognate with Akkadian 𒉺 (kappum, “wing, branch”), Arabic كَنَف (kanaf, “wing, side, bosom”), Ge'ez ክንፍ (kənf, “wing, fin”) and Hebrew כנף (wing).

examples.text: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግስት በሁለቱ መካከል ምንም አይት ልዩነት ሳያስቀምጥ በ 2021 የሐማስን የፖለቲካ ክንፍ እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅት ፈርጇል። "ሐማስ የተለያዩ ክፍሎች እንዳሉት አድርጎ ማቅረብ የማይመስል ነው። ሐማስ ውስብስብ ቢሆንም አንድ አሸባሪ ድርጅት ነው" ሲል ገልጾታል።
examples.ref: 2023, “ሐማስ በእስራኤሉ ጥቃት ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን አልገደልኩም አለ”, in BBC News:
examples.english: The UK government designated the political wing of Hamas as a terrorist organization in 2021, making no distinction between the two. "It is unlikely to present Hamas as having different parts. Although Hamas is complex, it is one terrorist organization," he explained.
examples.roman: yäyunaytəd kingədäm mängəst bähulätu mäkakäl mənm ʾäyt ləyunät sayasḳämṭ bä 2021 yäḥämasn yäpolätika kənf ʾəndä ʾäšäbari dərǧət färǧʷal. "ḥämas yätäläyayu kəfloč ʾəndalut ʾädrəgo maḳräb yämaymäsl näw. ḥämas wəsbəsb bihonm ʾänd ʾäšäbari dərǧət näw" sil gälṣotal.
examples.translation: The UK government designated the political wing of Hamas as a terrorist organization in 2021, making no distinction between the two. "It is unlikely to present Hamas as having different parts. Although Hamas is complex, it is one terrorist organization," he explained.

examples.text: በአማራ ክልል ደቡብ ጎንደር ዞን ላይ ጋይንት ወረዳ ባለፈው አርብ ሚያዚያ 9/2018 ዓ.ም. ሳሊ በተባለች አነስተኛ ከተማ የመንግሥት ወታደሮች በፈፀሙት ጥቃት ሰባት ሠዎች መገደላቸውን እና ቤተ ክርስቲያን ላይ ጉዳት መድረሱን ቢቢሲ ያነጋገራቸው ምንጮች ገለፁ።

examples.roman: bäʾämara kəll däbub gondär zon lay gaynət wäräda baläfäw ʾärb miyaziya 9/2018 ʿa.mə. sali bätäbaläč ʾänästäña kätäma yämängəśt wätadäroč bäfäṣ́ämut ṭəḳat säbat śäwoč mägädälačäwn ʾəna betä kərsətiyan lay gudat mädräsun bibisi yanägagäračäw mənč̣oč gäläṣ́u.

examples.text: ምዕራብ አፍሪካዊቷ አገር ሞሪታኒያ እስልምናን የሚያንቋሽሽ ድርጊት በፈጸሙ ሰዎች ላይ የሚተላለፈውን ቅጣት በተመለከተ የነበራትን ሕግ የበለጠ ያጠናከረችው በቅርብ ዓመታት ውስጥ ነው።
examples.ref: 2023 July 28, “በሞሪታኒያ ሃይማኖት ላይ ተሳልቃለች የተባለች ተማሪ በሞት የሚያስቀጣ ክስ ተመሠረተባት”, in BBC, archived from the original on 25 Mar 2024:
examples.roman: məʿrab ʾäfrikawitʷa ʾägär moritaniya ʾəsləmnan yämiyanḳʷašš dərgit bäfäṣämu säwoč lay yämitälaläfäwn ḳəṭat bätämäläkätä yänäbäratn ḥəg yäbäläṭä yaṭänakäräčw bäḳrəb ʿamätat wəsṭ näw.

examples.text: ውጤቱን ተከትሎ በምድቡ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ላይ የምትገኘው ሞሪታኒያ ነጥቧን ወደ ሰባት ከፍ በማድረግ ወደ ሩብ ፍጻሜ የመግባት እድሏን ሰፊ አድርጋለች።
examples.ref: 2025 August 14, “ሞሪታኒያ ወደ ሩብ ፍጻሜ የመግባት እድሏን ያሰፋችበትን ወሳኝ ድል ተቀዳጅታለች”, in ENA English, archived from the original on 17 May 2026:
examples.roman: wəṭetun täkätlo bämdəbu hulätäña däräǧa lay yämtəgäñäw moritaniya näṭbʷan wädä säbat käf bämadräg wädä rub fəṣame yämägbat ʾədlʷan säfi ʾädrəgaläč.

examples.text: የሠሜን ተራሮች ብሔራዊ ፓርክ እ.ኤ.አ በ1978 በዩኔስኮ የዓለም የተፈጥሮ ቅርስነት የተመዘገበ ሲሆን በ2009 ዓ.ም በዩኔስኮ የአደጋ ተጋላጭ የዓለም ቅርስ ዝርዝር ውስጥ ተካቶ ነበር።
examples.ref: 2021 November 27, “ዩኔስኮ፡ የመስቀል በዓልን ጨምሮ ኢትዮጵያ በተባበሩት መንግሥታት ድርጅት ያስመዘገበቻቸው 13 ቅርሶች [UNESCO: Ethiopia has 13 heritage sites registered by the United Nations, including the Meskel Festival]”, in BBC News, አማርኛ, archived from the original on 25 Mar 2024:
examples.english: The Northern Mountains National Park was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1978 and was added to the UNESCO List of World Heritage in Danger in 2009.
examples.roman: yäśämen täraroč bəḥerawi park ʾə.ʾe.ʾä bä1978 bäyunesko yäʿaläm yätäfäṭro ḳərsənät yätämäzägäbä sihon bä2009 ʿa.mə bäyunesko yäʾädäga tägalač̣ yäʿaläm ḳərs zərzər wəsṭ täkato näbär.
examples.translation: The Northern Mountains National Park was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1978 and was added to the UNESCO List of World Heritage in Danger in 2009.

examples.text: ዩኔስኮ ቅርሶችን የሚመዘግበው አገራት እ.አ.አ በ1972 የሚዳሰሱ ቅርሶችን ለመጠበቅ፤ እ.አ.አ በ2003 ደግሞ የማይዳሰሱ ቅርሶችን ለመጠበቅ በፈረንሳይ ርዕሰ መዲና ፓሪስ የፈረሟቸውን ስምምነቶች መሰረት በማድረግ ነው።
examples.ref: 2023 March 4, “ዩኔስኮ በኢትዮጵያ ለተመዘገቡ ዓለም አቀፍ ቅርሶች ጥበቃ አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ እያደረገ መሆኑን ገለጸ [UNESCO says it is providing necessary support for the protection of registered international heritage sites in Ethiopia]”, in የኢትዮጵያ ዜና አገልግሎት, archived from the original on 25 Jun 2026:
examples.english: UNESCO registers heritage sites based on agreements signed by countries in Paris in 1972 for the protection of tangible heritage and in 2003 for the protection of intangible heritage.
examples.roman: yunesko ḳərsočn yämimäzägbäw ʾägärat ʾə.ʾä.ʾä bä1972 yämidasäsu ḳərsočn lämäṭäbäḳ; ʾə.ʾä.ʾä bä2003 dägmo yämaydasäsu ḳərsočn lämäṭäbäḳ bäfäränsay rəʿsä mädina paris yäfärämʷačäwn səmmənätoč mäsärät bämadräg näw.
examples.translation: UNESCO registers heritage sites based on agreements signed by countries in Paris in 1972 for the protection of tangible heritage and in 2003 for the protection of intangible heritage.

examples.text: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግስት በሁለቱ መካከል ምንም አይት ልዩነት ሳያስቀምጥ በ 2021 የሐማስን የፖለቲካ ክንፍ እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅት ፈርጇል። "ሐማስ የተለያዩ ክፍሎች እንዳሉት አድርጎ ማቅረብ የማይመስል ነው። ሐማስ ውስብስብ ቢሆንም አንድ አሸባሪ ድርጅት ነው" ሲል ገልጾታል።
examples.ref: 2023, “ሐማስ በእስራኤሉ ጥቃት ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን አልገደልኩም አለ”, in BBC News:
examples.english: The UK government designated the political wing of Hamas as a terrorist organization in 2021, making no distinction between the two.
examples.roman: yäyunaytəd kingədäm mängəst bähulätu mäkakäl mənm ʾäyt ləyunät sayasḳämṭ bä 2021 yäḥämasn yäpolätika kənf ʾəndä ʾäšäbari dərǧət färǧʷal. "ḥämas yätäläyayu kəfloč ʾəndalut ʾädrəgo maḳräb yämaymäsl näw. ḥämas wəsbəsb bihonm ʾänd ʾäšäbari dərǧət näw" sil gälṣotal.
examples.translation: The UK government designated the political wing of Hamas as a terrorist organization in 2021, making no distinction between the two.
